Get details about the Administration and License Center of Sibley County.
Attorney
The Sibley County Attorney's Office became a full-time county attorney's office as of December 1, 2018.
Auditor-Treasurer
The Auditor-Treasurer Office interacts with multiple County departments.
Court Administration
Visit the Minnesota Judicial Branch website to learn about Court Administration.
Court Services / Probation
Sibley County Court Services provides probation and parole supervision for juvenile offenders, and adult misdemeanor offenders who reside in or are convicted in Sibley County.
Economic Development
Discover Sibley County's Economic Development Department services for businesses and visitors.
Extension
Sibley County Extension is a branch of the University of Minnesota Extension Service and provides educational events, seminars and information on ag related issues; home, garden and lawn issues; and also coordinates the youth 4-H program and Extension Home Study Program.
License Center
The License Center, a division of the Administration Office, provides services related to driver's licenses, game and fish licenses, motor vehicles, and recreational vehicles.

Public Works
Sibley County Public Works is responsible for the management and planning of Sibley County's transportation and park systems.
Recorder
The Recorder's Office is responsible for all the real estate records for properties located in Sibley County.
Sheriff
The Sheriff’s Office provides a full range of law enforcement services to the residents of Sibley County.
